LanguageData.Psyche_Setting_AttemptWithoutBestMedicin: Attempt therapy without best allowed medicine

When on, counselors hold psyche therapy sessions even when the best medicine allowed for the patient is not in stock, using lesser medicine or none - which lowers quality and can risk a botched, scar-worsening session. When off, a session waits until the best allowed medicine is on hand.
LanguageData.Psyche_SeekClarity_Desc: Send this colonist to contemplate a fully-healed deep psyche scar and try to turn it into a lasting clarity. Consumes {0} glitterworld medicine only if it succeeds. One attempt - the window closes afterward.
LanguageData.Psyche_SeekClarity_NoGlitter: Requires {0} glitterworld medicine available and unforbidden.
LanguageData.Psyche_Alert_SeekClarity_Desc: These colonists have fully healed a deep psyche scar and can turn it into a lasting clarity through contemplation. It costs {0} glitterworld medicine, and the chance passes after a while.\n\nUse the "Seek clarity" command on the colonist.
LanguageData.Psyche_Reflecting_Desc: This scar has been fully mended. For a short while it can be turned into a lasting clarity through a guided contemplation, costing {0} glitterworld medicine. Use the "Seek clarity" command.
LanguageData.Psyche_ClarityFormed: {0} worked through a healed scar and found a lasting clarity.
LanguageData.Psyche_ClarityFailed: {0} contemplated a healed scar, but no lasting clarity took hold.
LanguageData.Psyche_ScarTradedForAddiction: {0} buried a wound in the habit - their {1} faded, but a dependency took its place.
LanguageData.Psyche_RevengeClosure: {0} found a measure of peace at the death of {1}, who had taken someone they loved.
LanguageData.Psyche_MaimRevengeClosure: {0} found a measure of peace at the death of {1}, the one who maimed them - the raw wound of it settles, though the loss remains.
LanguageData.Psyche_BurialClosure: {0} found some closure laying {1} to rest, easing the grief they carried.
LanguageData.Psyche_BurialClosureBittersweet: {0} made peace with {1}'s passing at the burial - a long life, now laid to rest.
LanguageData.Psyche_LimbReplacedClosure: {0} has a better-than-flesh replacement for their lost {1}, and the phantom ache of the loss begins to settle.
LanguageData.Psyche_LimbReplacedClosure_Transhuman: {0} has replaced their lost {1} with machinery, and the augmentation soothes the trauma of the loss - flesh was only ever a starting point.
LanguageData.Psyche_LimbReplacedClosure_Purist: {0} has their {1} back in natural flesh, and being whole again lays the trauma of the loss to rest.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tip_Contemplating: The injury has faded but not fully settled - it may still leave a scar before it passes.
LanguageData.Psyche_Tip_PassesInScar: Passes in {0} - may leave a scar
LanguageData.Psyche_Tip_FadesInClarity: Fades in {0} - may mature into a clarity
LanguageData.Psyche_Tip_TierFloor: Mended as deep as current therapy allows. Research {0} to repair it deeper.
